purpose: Walk through a loan; teach 金利/供給/請求/保証/所有/不動産/証券/兆

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こちらが金利の説明資料です。
lines.en: Here’s the material explaining the interest rates.
lines.style: methodical advisor presenting documents, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 固定と変動、どちらの金利が得ですか？
lines.en: Fixed or variable — which rate is better?
lines.style: deliberating client comparing choices, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 将来の供給と需要を読むのは難しいですね。
lines.en: Reading future supply and demand is hard.
lines.style: honest advisor admitting uncertainty, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 毎月の請求額はいくらになりますか？
lines.en: What will the monthly bill be?
lines.style: budget-focused client asking directly, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 約十万円です。保証料も含まれています。
lines.en: About 100,000 yen. The guarantee fee is included.
lines.style: advisor giving a precise figure, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 物件の所有名義は妻と共同でも？
lines.en: Can the ownership be joint with my wife?
lines.style: client clarifying a personal detail, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 可能です。不動産の登記も手続きします。
lines.en: Yes. We’ll handle the real-estate registration too.
lines.style: helpful advisor confirming the steps, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 余った資金は証券で運用しようかな。
lines.en: Maybe I’ll invest spare funds in securities.
lines.style: forward-thinking client planning ahead, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 国の予算が何兆円という時代、賢い選択です。
lines.en: In an era of trillion-yen budgets, a wise choice.
lines.style: advisor affirming with perspective, voice clear and distinctly their own
